description: A heatmap matrix for Power BI — show a measure across two dimensions with colour intensity, ideal for spotting patterns, outliers, and trends across a grid of rows and columns at a glance. Codex Heatmap Matrix replaces standard cross-tab tables with a colour-coded view that makes data density and concentration immediately obvious. Configure the colour scheme to match your brand or status logic, and let the matrix adapt to any data shape. IDEAL FOR Day-of-week vs hour-of-day demand patterns Department vs metric scorecards Cohort analysis grids (cohort month vs months since signup) Geographic vs time-period performance views Any two-dimensional measure where the pattern matters more than precise numbers KEY FEATURES Four colour scheme presets — Green to Red, Red to Green, Sequential, plus Custom with Low / Mid / High / Zero pickers Configurable cell border radius for subtle to bold visual styling Toggle to show or hide measure values inside cells Number or percent formatting with configurable decimal places Column ordering — Auto or Weekday Header font size and colour controls Optional internal title with full font and alignment controls Full font controls on every text element Hover tooltip showing row, column, and value Click to cross-filter other visuals High contrast mode support Handles up to 30,000 rows via dataReductionAlgorithm PRO TIP For day-of-week vs hour-of-day…
